rows.grounds: instrumental of hṛdaya, referring to the heart-mantra used in ritual placement
optative verb expressing prescribed ritual action
object of placement; surface form uncertain, possibly related to kumbha in ritual context
compound svarṇa-ādi with causative verb indicating insertion of gold and other materials

items.question: What ritual actions and materials are prescribed for placing and filling the pots?
premises: The heart-mantra is the means for the act of placement.
The pots are the objects to be placed.
Gold and other materials are to be deposited into them.
items.inference: The ritual procedure requires placing the pots with the heart-mantra and depositing gold and other materials into them.
uncertainties: The form mumbhān is unclear and may be a variant or corruption of kumbhān.
items.plain_english: One should place the pots with the heart-mantra and deposit gold and other materials into them.
